1.explanation:
• Pagination.js: This file builds the main Pagination component and is responsible for rendering the page‐number dropdown as well as the textual label when `pagesUnknown` is true. The duplicate display logic needs to be adjusted here.  
• Pagination-test.js: The unit tests validate pagination rendering, including the `pagesUnknown` behavior. They must be updated to expect the corrected UI (no redundant text).  
• PaginationNav.js: This file drives the navigation controls (previous/next buttons and the “page X” text when pages are unknown). It currently adds the extra label and must be patched to suppress the text when the dropdown already communicates the current page.  
• PaginationNav-test.js: The corresponding unit tests for the navigation component will fail under the new behavior and need to be revised to match the intended output.  
• e2e Pagination-test.e2e.js: The end‐to‐end tests for Pagination verify the presence and content of the page counter UI. They must be updated to stop checking for the duplicated text and assert only the dropdown’s selected value or a single label as appropriate.
1.bug_scenario: When the Pagination component is rendered with the prop `pagesUnknown={true}`, the current page number is shown twice: once as the selected value in the dropdown and again as plain text immediately following it. For example, instead of seeing just “Page <select>1</select>”, the UI renders “1 <select>1</select> page 1”, duplicating the page count and cluttering the interface.

2.explanation: Both of these files contain the rendering logic for the “unknown pages” variant of the Pagination component.  Pagination.js is the top-level component that branches on pagesUnknown and delegates the page-selector UI to the experimental/PageSelector.  PageSelector.js is where the <select> and the adjacent text label (“page X”) are assembled, and currently it outputs the page number twice.  Those two files will need to be updated so that when pagesUnknown is true the number is shown only once.
2.bug_scenario: When you set the Pagination prop pagesUnknown to true the control renders the current page twice – once inside the <select> and a second time immediately afterwards in plain text.  For example it shows “1 page 1”, “2 page 2” and so on, which is redundant.  You only ever need to display the page once.
